items.name: Ai Knowledge
items.description: run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 -- static instrument checks + all in-repo check-*.py, including the script-inventory rule that fails if any checker is hosted by no gate.

items.name: Beta Release Evidence
items.description: The ~540s, ~10-producer release-ceremony evidence set (sample-matrix, stateful-additive-migrations, etc).

items.name: Beta Release
items.description: run-beta-release-gate.ps1 evaluate-only pass (fast: does the evidence that already exists say the release is ready).

items.name: Canary Build Boot Smoke
items.description: Generate + build + boot npdev-canary (the ONE frozen T1 fixture, Sec.5) and run its REST smoke plan (health, one flow, one panel).

items.name: Check Adr Decision Implementation
items.description: S4 Phase B: an ADR decision the owner accepted (opt-in, via a ```decision-check fenced block naming a file + required substring) still has live code behind it. Closes the gap ADR-0011 D4 exposed -- accepted in S2's own gate, recorded in the ADR, never implemented, found only by running the S3 codemod against real content. Starts with ADR-0011's D1-D4 only. 2026-08-23 (Wave 6 of the 2026-08-23 defect-remediation session): invokedBy corrected -- R4 Part C moved the underlying check from run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 to run-weekly-paperwork-checks.ps1, but this entry still named the old caller, so cadence_state.py could never see a fresh run recorded against reality; also wired the missing cadence_state.py record call into the check's real host.

items.name: Check Dsl Coverage
items.description: Every DSL feature detector has at least one corpus model exercising it.

items.name: Check Panel Provenance Impact
items.description: A field/panel rename does not silently break a hand-written screen, discovered against whatever is currently built under the Build root.

items.name: Check Schema Mirror Consistency
items.description: The 4 model.schema.json copies stay semantically identical. Cheap enough to run on every edit.

items.name: Check Twin Pair Consistency
items.description: S6 (drift A3): reads scripts/quality/twin-pair-registry.json's human-curated list of location pairs that must move together (e.g. the four-place chain for a new top-level model array field, both directions of pack-composition) and fails the moment any pair diverges. 2026-08-23 (Wave 6 of the 2026-08-23 defect-remediation session): this check ran (hosted by the knowledge gate, step [20/39]) on every gate pass, but nothing ever called cadence_state.py record for it, so this entry's maxStaleness could never be satisfied and it showed permanently OVERDUE no matter how often it actually ran. Wired the missing record call into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 right where the check already executes.

items.name: Dsl Conformance Max Generate
items.description: dsl-conformance-max still emits cleanly (NPDevSamples/scripts/generate-sample-app.ps1 -SampleId dsl-conformance-max -NoAssembleFinalApp -- emission only, no build/boot).

items.name: Dsl Test Touched Area
items.description: gradlew :NPDevContract:dsl:test --tests <touched area>. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -DslTestFilter was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.

items.name: Generator
items.description: run-generator-gate.ps1 -- the codegen engine, including the full 30-model corpus.

items.name: Kernel
items.description: W3.2 (2026-08-25 remediation plan / QUAL-32): run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 -- kernelQualityGate (:kernel:test + all 36+ :adapters:*:test) from NPDevKernel's own Gradle root, then the coverage ratchet against the fresh aggregate. Closes the gap the kernel note in scripts/policy/coverage-baseline.json used to describe: kernelQualityGate existed as a real Gradle task invoked by nothing, so the recorded floor (73.0968) had drifted 10 points from a full-suite measurement (62.69) before anything noticed.

items.name: Model Validate Touched
items.description: npdev validate model against the specific model.json being edited. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -ModelPath was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.

items.name: Rebuild Calibration
items.description: Move 14 A1: the full-rebuild wall-clock baseline (measured 573s on 2026-08-01) the entire fast-lane tiering plan justifies itself against. A build-time regression is exactly the slow drift this ledger exists to surface -- re-time it periodically rather than letting the one number the plan rests on go stale and unverified.

items.name: Runtime Host
items.description: run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 -- an assembled sample app + its test suite, including WmsOffice-class interaction surfaces.

items.name: Scale Baseline
items.description: S1 O1 (2026-08-03): the regression baseline for ConceptQueryPredicateCompiler/JdbcBusinessConceptStore's SQL pushdown at 100k rows -- all three read paths sub-second with real WHERE/LIMIT/GROUP BY in the emitted SQL, none streamed the full table through the JVM. LC-P0 fixed the architecture; nobody had run it at volume before this baseline. A baseline nobody re-measures is the SCREEN_TAXONOMY staleness failure again -- see __OutsideRepo/s1/scale-baseline-2026-08-03.txt for the full numbers.

items.name: Scale Proof Ladder
items.description: ROADMAP.md card R9 / ledger SCALE-1: the 5-rung (26/50/100/260/520 concepts) nightly model-scale ladder -- synthesize/generate/ddl/build/boot/firstRequest/latency/memory per rung, recorded to scripts/policy/scale-proof-baseline.json. The nightly CI run is the durable schedule; this cadence entry is informational bookkeeping in the same spirit as scale-baseline below, since CI's own cadence_state.py record call does not persist across runner-ephemeral checkouts -- a human re-running it locally and recording is what keeps this id out of 'never-run'.

items.name: Weekly Paperwork
items.description: GATE-SPLIT (2026-08-25 remediation plan W4.5): the gate-level entry for run-weekly-paperwork-checks.ps1's 11 doc/process-hygiene checkers -- distinct from each individual checker's own cadence entry above (check-adr-decision-implementation, etc.), this tracks the AGGREGATE gate run itself so run-all-gates.ps1's own -Only weeklyPaperwork invocation satisfies check-cadence-coverage.py the same way every other gate in its $gates array must. Reuses T3 (not a new tier) since this repo's cadence system has exactly four; deferred for a DIFFERENT reason than betaRelease (slower-moving process hygiene, not release ceremony), hence its own -IncludePaperwork switch rather than sharing -IncludeReleaseGate.
